newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion market closed for Good Friday.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion market closed for Good Friday.

text.p: The Bombay bullion market was closed on account of Good Friday. Trading resumes on Saturday.
On Thursday, gold 24 carat ended 10 rupees higher at 4,690 rupees per 10 grammes but off the day's opening 4,700 rupees as demand resistance capped early gains towards close.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) closed 200 rupees higher at 54,900 rupees per piece but off the opening 55,000 rupees.
Silver (.999) ended 40 rupees higher at 7,340 rupees per kg on limited supplies and an uptrend in the world market. (Conversion $1=35.89 rupees)
